addressed.finding: No independent pixel/RGBA budget below the dimension cap
addressed.triage: The existing 8192-square dimension cap already bounded RGBA to 256 MiB; the original unbounded characterization was too strong. Added explicit caller control with a 64 MiB default.
addressed.change: max_pixels enforced before native probing, during codec allocation and before Rust RGBA allocation; cancellation precedes allocation
addressed.verification: Real H264 coded-padding and small/invalid budget tests; full gate and ASan/UBSan

addressed.finding: Source-only sanitizer reports included irrelevant worker artifact fields
addressed.change: Report only selected package artifacts; worker fields require worker selection
addressed.verification: Four native harness tests and final source/media sanitizer report

addressed.finding: Invalid native limits were checked after host snapshot copying
addressed.change: Pure Rust DecodeLimits::validate runs before any snapshot read; C independently rechecks
addressed.verification: Seven invalid-limit configurations with a reader that panics on any read; full gate and ASan/UBSan

addressed.finding: Stream HDR metadata could bypass frame-only checks while transfer tags claimed SDR
addressed.change: Check stream and selected packet side data before decode; extend frame checks to HDR/ICC/ambient metadata
addressed.verification: 618-byte encoded FFV1 fixture failed before the fix and passes after it; ten native integration tests and final gate/sanitizers

dismissed.finding: Fixture generator should compare av_packet_side_data_add result with < 0
dismissed.evidence: Pinned FFmpeg 8.0.3 libavcodec/packet.h:442-448 returns AVPacketSideData* on success and NULL on failure. Existing ! check is correct. Two actual generator runs reproduced identical fixture bytes.
